items.quote: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
items.claim: Moses let his father-in-law leave, and the father-in-law went back to his own land.
items.place: his own land (not named in the text)
items.mechanism: Departure: the father-in-law returns home with Moses's permission. The verse is numbered 18:27. Model-prior (unverified): this is probably Exodus 18:27, and the father-in-law is probably Jethro of Midian. The text itself names neither.
